ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2026 DPS (fy_fact, period ended 2026-06-30) — no quarterly DPS fact since
dividends.dps_basis_detail: paid facts for periods ending 2009-06-30..2026-06-30; declared FY facts for 2 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no paid FY fact and no four paid quarterly facts (2012-06-30, 2013-06-30); the declared tag stopped: its newest fact (2015-06-30) is 4018 days older than the paid tag's (2026-06-30) — paid is primary
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2024-12-31, 2025-03-31, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31) (the FY count — 2 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2026 (2025-07-01..2026-06-30) plus one payment carried only in the FY total — reads irregular); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

share_issuance.basis: 4/4 quarters covered: the full-year year-to-date fact 2025-07-01..2026-06-30 = 0 (ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised, filed 2026-08-13)

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters covered: the full-year year-to-date fact 2025-07-01..2026-06-30 = 0 (ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised, filed 2026-08-13)); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
